Name: Wizard Portrait and Sprites VM
Author: VitaleMarino
Description:
english is not my native language, sorry for the mistakes if there are any!

HOW TO INSTALL
Move both folders from the archive to the Mods folder located in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods.

IF YOU USE "SEASONAL CUTE CHARACTERS"
Unfortunately, sprites won't work if you have Seasonal Cute Characters installed. In order not to delete the entire mod, you need to go to the folder C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters\assets\Characters and find the "Wizard" folder there. Delete this folder or move it. Do the same with the SVE version, but in addition to the "Wizard" folder, you need to delete or move the "Magnus" folder.
I apologize for such difficulties, I'm not much of a programmer! :(
